rawReview.evidence: The SRD Help action grants Advantage to the next attack by an ally against an enemy within 5 feet and expires at the helper’s next turn (Rules-Glossary.md:528-534). The supplied 5-foot and 10-foot geometry, Skeleton Shortbow range, 5-foot melee reach, illumination, initiative order, and A2 turn-boundary assumption make the sequence legal and executable; no unresolved RAW choice requires a Table Decision.
